findings.evidence: The generic section quantifies only over `C`, `J`, `R`, and `SheafOfModules M N`; its scheme dependency first appears at line 153 with `variable (X : Scheme.{u})`.
findings.fix: Move lines 58–151 to an earlier file such as `TauCeti/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/Invertible.lean`; have `LineBundle/Basic.lean` import it and retain only the `Scheme` object property, full subcategory, and trivial object.
findings.issue: `LocalGeneratorsData.IsInvertible`, `SheafOfModules.IsInvertible`, its isomorphism transport, and `free_isInvertible` (lines 69–148) are defined for arbitrary sites and do not depend on schemes, so placing them in an algebraic-geometry line-bundle file makes generic sheaf theory depend on a later topic.

summary: The scheme-level packaging belongs under `AlgebraicGeometry/LineBundle`, but the broadly reusable site-level theory is placed too late in the dependency hierarchy.
